alt_text: Cover: Spain non-lucrative visa, every document. Swipe, save, tick them off.
Forms and ID: national visa application form, signed form EX-01, passport valid one year or more with two free pages, one recent passport photo.
Proof of means: 2,400 euros a month, 400 percent of IPREM, plus 600 euros a month per family member, shown for 12 months or as regular income.
Health and background: Spain-authorised health insurance, criminal record covering the last five years, medical certificate.
Admin: proof of address in the consular district, form 790 code 052 fee paid, apostille and Spanish translation.
The detail that trips people up: the criminal record and medical certificate are valid for 6 months, so order them last.
Spain Non-Lucrative Visa Kit, 49 euros: dossier index with means calculation, letter of intent in Spanish and English, sworn statement of non-activity. Link in bio.

alt_text: Cover: UK spouse visa, the documents to gather. Swipe, save, tick them off.
Identity: current passport or travel ID, photo and stamp pages of old passports, TB test results if your country is listed.
Financial requirement: 29,000 pounds a year, combined income for most new partner applicants since 11 April 2024; savings can also count.
Your relationship: marriage or civil partnership certificate, or proof of two or more years living together, and proof you intend to live together in the UK.
English and translations: an approved English test or qualification, and a certified translation of any non-English document.
The proof that trips people up: if employed, GOV.UK lists 6 months of payslips, bank statements showing that pay, and a dated employer letter on headed paper.
UK Spouse and Partner Visa Kit, 59 euros: sponsor and employer letters, relationship evidence file, cover letter. Link in bio.
